create.name: Miles Borrero
create.bio:
Miles Borrero is a New York yoga teacher, kirtan musician and writer who grew up in Colombia and found yoga while training as an actor in the United States. Over roughly twenty-five years he has studied across many yoga lineages as well as Buddhism and tantra, and he looks for the threads that connect them rather than holding to a single method. His classes pair strong, carefully built vinyasa with breathwork, mantra, restorative practice and meditation, and he is known among other teachers for his work on sequencing and on the ethics of touch and hands-on assists. He is queer and trans, and his memoir Beautiful Monster: A Becoming (2023) tells the story of his transition at forty and how yoga carried him through it.

He teaches public classes at St. Marks Yoga in Manhattan, sees private students at his home studio in East Harlem and on Zoom, and leads community kirtan in New York and New England. He is part of the R&R teaching team at Kripalu, where he also offers his own weekend programmes, and he runs continuing-education trainings for yoga teachers. With his partner Sarah Jill he hosts small, queer- and trans-led group retreats, including a week in northern Morocco.

books.title: Beautiful Monster: A Becoming
books.author: Miles Borrero
books.description: Miles Borrero's memoir of growing up in Colombia in the 1980s and 1990s, moving to the United States to act, and finding a home in New York's yoga world. It follows his decision to transition at forty as his father was dying, told with humour and touches of magical realism.

courses.title: Crafting the Year Ahead: Music, Magic, and Vinyasa
courses.description: A New Year weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, mixing vinyasa, live chanting, partner bodywork, restorative yoga and journaling. Miles also brings the Colombian Año Viejo tradition as a playful way to let go of the old year and set hopes for the next.

courses.title: Moroccan Magic Yoga Retreat
courses.description: An eight-day group retreat for up to twelve people at a family-run guesthouse on the coast near Tangier, led by Miles and Sarah Jill. Days combine morning yoga and further sessions with excursions planned with local hosts.

courses.title: Beyond Sequencing: Uplevel Your Yoga Teaching
courses.description: A residential weekend training for yoga teachers at Groundworks in the Catskills, worth 20 Yoga Alliance continuing-education hours. Miles teaches how to build classes from first principles instead of templates, so teachers develop their own voice.

courses.title: Private Yoga Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions, mostly over Zoom, shaped around each student's goals, from first steps in yoga and its philosophy to breathwork, mantra, yoga nidra or advanced postures. In-person sessions can be arranged for a travel fee.

courses.title: Tantra Unveiled
courses.description: A recorded 20-hour continuing-education module that works through Pandit Rajmani Tigunait's book of the same name. Ten sessions mix practice with discussion of the philosophy behind tantric yoga.

courses.title: The Lost Teachings Of Yoga
courses.description: A recorded 20-hour course built around Georg Feuerstein's audio teaching of the same name. Sessions combine physical practice with the less familiar esoteric side of the yoga tradition.

courses.title: Myth, Mantra & The Authentic Self
courses.description: A recorded two-and-a-half-hour workshop on the myths and mantras behind familiar yoga postures. It uses these stories as a way to explore and express a more authentic voice.
